ORDINANCE XXXVI OF 1983
ORDINANCE XXXVI OF 1983
STATE BANK OF PAKISTAN (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
An Ordinance further to amend the State Bank of Pakistan Act, 1956
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part 1, 31st December, 1983]
No. F. 17 (1)/83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
l. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the State Bank of Pakistan (Amendment) Ordinance, 1983.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: State Bank of Pakistan Amendment Ordinance 1983
sections.description:
Substitution of section 49, Act XXXIII of 1956

ORDINANCE XXXVI OF 1983
ORDINANCE XXXVI OF 1983
STATE BANK OF PAKISTAN (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
An Ordinance further to amend the State Bank of Pakistan Act, 1956
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part 1, 31st December, 1983]
No. F. 17 (1)/83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
2. Substitution of section 49, Act XXXIII of 1956.--In the State
Bank of Pakistan Act, 1956 (XXXIII of 1956), for section 49 the following shall
be substituted, namely :-
"49.
Exemption from business profit-tax, gift-tax, wealth-tax, income-tax and
super-tax.-Notwithstanding anything contained in the Business Profits Tax Act,
1.947 (XXI of 1947), the Gift-tax Act, 1963 (XIV of 1963), the Wealth-tax Act,
1963 (XV of 1963), the Income-tax Ordinance, 11)7:' (XXXI of 1979), or any
other law for the time being in force in Pakistan relating to business
profits-tax, gift-tax, wealth-tax, income-tax or super-tax, the Bank shall not
be liable to pay business profits tax, gift-tax, wealth tax, income-tax
super-tax, on any of its profits, gains, wealth or income or any gifts made by
it".
